inventory_reference_scope: Actual executed sealed inventory Hash is bound by intent, copy result and final300 verification; publication reads only the canonical receipt and does not re-open current inputs.

publication_scope.input_source: existing Root canonical reproduction receipt only

snapshot_caveats: The actual copy result pending flag describes its earlier moment before uv/load; later positive and release evidence prove those steps completed.
Clean/Hash/inode facts describe the saved release-time state; the current Root-owned checkout, ledger and subsequent preflight/Native progress are not inspected.
The recorded input Hash map is a historical reproduction snapshot, not a new read of current Model/Runtime/Source files.
Dataset and input preparation failures outside this actual reproduction are retained by their separate preparation evidence and are not counted as reproduction retries.
